# CoachConnect AI - Project Structure Overview

## 📁 Root Files (Essential)
- **App.js** ✅ **IMPLEMENTED** - Main app entry point with navigation and theme
- **app.json** ✅ **IMPLEMENTED** - Expo configuration
- **package.json** ✅ **IMPLEMENTED** - Dependencies and scripts
- **babel.config.js** ✅ **IMPLEMENTED** - Babel configuration
- **env.example** ✅ **IMPLEMENTED** - Environment variables template
- **README.md** ✅ **IMPLEMENTED** - Project documentation
- **FIREBASE_SETUP.md** ✅ **IMPLEMENTED** - Firebase setup guide

## 📁 iOS Native Files (Auto-generated, Don't Edit)
- **ios/** - iOS native project files (auto-generated by Expo)
  - Podfile, Podfile.lock, Pods/ - CocoaPods dependencies
  - CoachConnect.xcodeproj/ - Xcode project
  - build/ - Build artifacts

## 📁 Assets (Optional/Placeholder)
- **assets/** - App icons and splash screens
  - icon.png, splash.png, adaptive-icon.png

## 📊 Summary

### ✅ **Currently Active (Essential)**
1. **App.js** - Main app with navigation
2. **Theme System** - ThemeContext, theme.js
3. **Common Components** - Button, Input, Card, Modal, LoadingSpinner
4. **Bottom Navigation** - BottomNavBar
5. **Settings Screen** - SettingsScreen with theme toggle
6. **Chat List Screen** - ChatListScreen (basic)

### ⚠️ **Not Implemented (Can Be Deleted or Implemented Later)**
- All auth screens
- All workout screens
- All nutrition screens
- All body/voice/supplements screens
- All trainer/client screens
- All services (Firebase, Supabase, AI, etc.)
- All hooks
- All store files
- All utility functions
- Most components (except common ones)

### 🗑️ **Can Safely Delete (If Not Needed)**
- All stub screen files (if you're not using them)
- All stub component files (if you're not using them)
- All stub service files (if you're not using them)
- All stub hook files (if you're not using them)
- All stub store files (if you're not using them)
- Navigation files (AppNavigator, MainNavigator, AuthNavigator) - Not currently used

### 💡 **Recommendation**
1. **Keep:** All files in `src/config/`, `src/context/`, `src/components/common/`, `src/components/navigation/`
2. **Keep:** `App.js`, `src/screens/profile/SettingsScreen.js`, `src/screens/chat/ChatListScreen.js`
3. **Delete or Implement:** All other stub files depending on your needs
4. **Focus on:** Implementing features one at a time rather than having many empty files
